title: senna charlesiana
intro: Senna charlesiana, commonly known as Bitter Senna, is a plant species that belongs to the Fabaceae family, known for its medicinal properties and uses. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating digestive issues such as constipation and diarrhea due to its laxative properties. The therapeutic actions of Senna charlesiana include stimulating bowel movements, reducing inflammation, and providing antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal effects include glycosides, anthraquinones, and flavonoids, which work together to provide its therapeutic benefits.
